title: Unbrewed Telemetry Sandbox Events v1
description: A batch of sandbox (non-Pro) room lifecycle events emitted by the Go relay so sandbox usage can be counted. A separate bucket: nothing here joins to games/game_seats or feeds a balance stat. Players arrive only as playerHash; a raw name (name, playerName, displayName) is refused.

schemaVersion.description: Optional. The version of record is the request path (/v1/sandbox-events); the relay stamps it so a stored batch is self-describing.

events.description: At least one event. An empty batch is a producer bug, not a no-op.

eventId.description: Unique per event. A re-sent event is a no-op, so producer retries are safe.

roomId.description: The sandbox lobby gid as the relay sees it.

playerHash.description: Relay-side HMAC of the normalized player name with a relay-only salt, 16 lowercase hex chars.

connections.description: Live connections in the room after this join or leave.

heroName.description: Sent once per (room, player, hero), the first time that player's blob carries pool.hero.name.

reason.description: Why the room closed: inactive (12h GC) or shutdown (relay SIGTERM).

ts.description: Producer clock at the moment of the event.
